en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ismail, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Which thing do you for work?’ I said, ‘I do not do any work these days’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Like that your wealth would go away and it will be difficult upon you’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu ‘Isma’il from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once asked, ‘What do you do?’ I replied, ‘I am not doing anything today.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘This is how your wealth goes away and it becomes difficult for you.’”
